correctness.rationale: For the source oscillator equations, \(W=w+ip\) and \(V=q+iz\) obey \(\dot W=i\omega_1W\) and \(\dot V=i\omega_2V\). Hence \(I_1=|W|^2\) and \(I_2=|V|^2\) are exact first integrals, and at \(\omega_2=2\omega_1\) the complex polynomial \(K=V\overline W^2\) is constant. The printed forcing and every common time translate have \(K=1\). Exact rational substitution of the Figure 11(b) oscillator initial values gives \(K=(117-44i)/125\), proving that no time shift maps that autonomous run to the printed forcing. A dependency-free exact polynomial checker verifies all identities.

value.rationale: The source pairs a bifurcation diagram and Lyapunov diagram as diagnostics of one resonantly forced parameter sweep. The exact invariant proves that the two computations live on different relative-phase leaves, a reproducibility condition that can alter the forcing waveform and potentially the dynamics. The result is therefore more than a normalization check: it identifies a concrete structural obstruction to comparing two published diagnostics without an additional phase-independence theorem.
